fusions.name: Haul Down
fusions.desc: A heavy lunge that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Press
fusions.desc: Shoulders into every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 5 damage. The damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Heave Together
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Vise Grip
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
